gap: Locate high-spin angular forecast error using causal counterfactual command response.

source.simulator: Crazyflow 0.3.2 through glassbox-throw at source commit 9bd74c1

measurement.response: Central finite difference of body rate with respect to one issued command at the origin. Replay the recorded later commands unchanged. Branch from the exact recorded state and hidden applied rotor condition; the learner sees neither the hidden rotor condition nor arm ratio.
measurement.forecast: At each origin freeze the public OnlineFit session fitted only on completed observations. Compare its 250 ms conditional rate forecast with recorded motion and a hold-rate reference.
measurement.scope: Both recordings are development evidence, not blind holdouts. The behavior controller created the tape and the model never controlled the plant. Counterfactual truth measures the response to an isolated command perturbation, not whole-controller success.
